2609.24362.title: VLM-in-Sandbox: Visual Workspaces for Agentic Visual Reasoning
2609.24362.paper_summary: Sandboxed computer environments support multi-step reasoning with tools, executable programs, and persistent files, yet their extension from language models to vision-language models (VLMs) introduces a distinct state-management problem. Visual reasoning produces intermediate image-valued evidence---crops, masks, overlays, zoomed regions, and analytic renderings---that must remain addressable without accumulating unboundedly in multimodal context. We introduce VLM-in-Sandbox, a training-free framework for agentic multimodal reasoning in controlled computer environments. Its Visual Workspace registers generated artifacts in an image ledger, maintains a bounded active visual context, and lets the model explicitly promote selected evidence for subsequent inspection. This separates visual evidence generation, performed by sandbox tools, from visual evidence management. Across seven benchmarks and four base VLMs, VLM-in-Sandbox achieves the highest sample-weighted average accuracy among Vanilla VLM, Append-only Sandbox, and the proposed method. A compiler-matched $2\times2$ study on 1,260 examples further separates model-directed visibility from bounded retention: VLM-in-Sandbox reaches 66.27% accuracy with 18.6% fewer total tokens than the automatic, retain-all control. Over all 6,350 submitted GPT-4.1-mini examples, it produces 302 rescues and 142 regressions relative to Original Append-only. A local vLLM study with prefix caching confirms that the smaller request workload also reduces uncached tokens, time to first token, and end-to-end latency. These results identify explicit visual evidence state as a central abstraction for sandboxed VLM agents.
2609.24362.paper_summary_zh: 沙盒計算環境支持使用工具、可執行程序和持久文件進行多步推理，但從語言模型擴展到視覺-語言模型（VLMs）引入了一個獨特的狀態管理問題。視覺推理產生中間的圖像值證據——裁切圖、遮罩、覆蓋、放大區域和分析渲染——這些證據必須在多模態上下文中保持可尋址，而不會無限制地累積。我們介紹了VLM-in-Sandbox，這是一個無需訓練的框架，旨在在受控計算環境中進行代理的多模態推理。它的視覺工作區在圖像賬本中註冊生成的工件，維持一個有限的主動視覺上下文，並讓模型明確促進選定的證據以供後續檢查。這將由沙盒工具執行的視覺證據生成與視覺證據管理分開。在七個基準和四個基礎VLM中，VLM-in-Sandbox在Vanilla VLM、僅附加沙盒和所提議的方法中達到了最高的樣本加權平均準確率。在1,260個示例上的編譯器匹配$2\times2$研究進一步將模型導向的可見性與有限保留分開：VLM-in-Sandbox以66.27%的準確率達成，且總標記數比自動保留所有的控制少18.6%。在所有6,350個提交的GPT-4.1-mini示例中，它相對於原始僅附加產生了302次救援和142次回歸。一項帶有前綴緩存的本地vLLM研究確認，較小的請求工作負載也減少了未緩存的標記、首次標記的時間和端到端延遲。這些結果確定了明確的視覺證據狀態作為沙盒VLM代理的核心抽象。
